summary: Reinforce artifact verification instructions in the json plain template to further reduce premature task completion based on round 1 evidence.

edits.hypothesis: Strengthening the artifact verification instruction in terminus-json-plain.txt with explicit empirical proof requirements prevents the model from prematurely declaring task completion without checking final artifacts.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose instructions in the prompt template are the appropriate lever to remind the frozen LLM policy of necessary pre-completion verification steps.

retroactive_check.corrective: On tasks like bn-fit-modify, reminding the model of mandatory empirical verification prevents skipping file checks before calling task_complete.
retroactive_check.preservative: Does not disrupt iterative_artifact_generation success habit because it reinforces the exact behavior already observed in successful trials.
retroactive_check.transfer: Generalizes to any coding/sysadmin task requiring generated artifact files.

edits.regression_risk: Slight token overhead or unnecessary extra verification check command, but within acceptable parameters.
edits.mechanism: Strengthening the artifact verification instruction in terminus-json-plain.txt with explicit empirical proof requirements prevents the model from prematurely declaring task completion without checking final artifacts.
